# Check Emails

**Provider:** [Google Workspace](../index)

Lists Gmail messages matching an optional Gmail search query and fetches
metadata for each result so agents can inspect sender, recipients, subject,
date, snippet, message id, and thread id.

## Command Path

google-workspace, check-emails

## Categories

email, communication

## Aliases

search gmail, read inbox, check mail

## Provider Parameters

bearer_token, gmail_base_url, calendar_base_url

## Input Parameters

include_spam_trash, label_ids, max_results, query, user_id

## Output Fields

messages, next_page_token, result_size_estimate

## Input Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  user_id:
    type: string
    description: Gmail user id or email address. Use "me" for the authenticated user.
  query:
    type: string
    description: Gmail search query, such as "from:alice@example.com is:unread".
  label_ids:
    type: array
    description: Gmail label IDs to filter by. CLI accepts comma-separated values.
    items:
      type: string
  max_results:
    type: integer
    description: Maximum messages to return, capped at 50.
  include_spam_trash:
    type: boolean
    description: Include messages from Spam and Trash.
```

## Output Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  messages:
    type: array
    description: Matching Gmail message summaries.
    items:
      type: object
  result_size_estimate:
    type: integer
    description: Gmail estimate of total matching results.
  next_page_token:
    type: string
    description: Token for the next Gmail result page when available.
```
